dc:description: One saved adopted institutional count-model target per ownership population and degree target, with both saved interval families on the same record.
dc:title: Institutional count associations
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: result_id: DEP3_count_primary_reference.result_id; value: rate_ratio; log_value: log_rate_ratio; percent_change: percent_change; lower_pointwise: pointwise95_lower; upper_pointwise: pointwise95_upper; lower_familywise: familywise95_lower; upper_familywise: familywise95_upper; support_clusters: cluster_count; pvalue: pvalue; family_adjusted_pvalue: bonferroni_family3_pvalue
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
